content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced in-store sales and merchandising for packaged goods is field execution, not an advertising, PR or agency network business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Owns billboards, rural broadband and insurance businesses; it sells ad space rather than providing agency services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Economic and litigation consulting for law firms and regulators; no advertising, PR or marketing services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, failure analysis and forensic consulting; technical expert services unrelated to marketing communications."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare, education and operational consulting plus revenue cycle outsourcing; no marketing or media services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, construction and government infrastructure services; a project-based business unrelated to marketing."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Agency network providing advertising, media buying, public relations and marketing services to large brands, closely matching Stagwell."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases out-of-home ad displays; it is a media owner selling space, not an agency providing marketing services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Contract staffing for engineering, healthcare and IT; sells people's time rather than marketing or communications work."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Native ad recommendation software platform that places ads on publisher sites; a technology platform rather than an agency network."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer support, content moderation and AI data labeling; back-office operations rather than marketing services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad buying software sold to agencies; a self-serve ad-tech platform rather than a full-service agency business."}]}
